$note: The fleet's annotation registry, read by every conformance/drift lane through scripts/annotations.mjs. LAW (operator ruling 2026-08-14, vault fleet/rulings/2026-08-14-rulings-annotate-never-suppress.md): nothing in this file removes an item from a lane's output — an entry ATTACHES a classification and its ruling citation to a difference that is reported either way, and (for anticipated updates) a CLOSURE CONDITION the lane evaluates mechanically every sync. Entries live here, in the checkers' own repo, rather than in a project's figma-map.json: the maps say what code claims, the rulings say how the fleet reads a difference, and mixing the two is what let a ratification quietly edit the defect surface. See scripts/annotations.mjs's header for the entry schema and the closure-predicate kinds; the axis-lane entries are mirrored into the Figma plugin (which cannot read files) and held in sync by scripts/annotations-registry.test.mjs.
